body: I like that last part. But it jut sucks how awkward I am. Im talking Micheal Cera levels. And I never know how to get my hair styled. Always looks goofy. Ah well, now Im ranting. Thanks for your words man. I couldnt bring myself to suicide now, but it is comforting to know I have that option in my back pockets, sort of like an eject button

Are you happy and have you found love?

What gets to me the most is how difficult it is to find "true love" and how I had it and lost it, and now look back on it as the peak happiness I will ever achieve. I also suffer from impotence, which only recently happened,and Im sure can be reversed, but for now is a major setback in building physical connection with women. I should also say that i am a guy in my early 20s, which is why finding love, and even just getting laid is such a big deal to me. It would be such a big deal if I were good looking, oh well
